race.comment: AMAZARA (6) hasn't been too far away at the past few efforts and strikes a very winnable contest here. Gets the services of Lerena in the stirrups and should be right there when the judge calls a halt. SKELDERGATE (1) has hit the top-four in three of four starts to date and will be ready to peak now third-up from the spell. Sure to run well. IN THE HOLE TIGER (4) strips fitter third-up and only needs some luck from the wide draw to be playing a major role in the finish. IF YOU ASKED ME TO (3) next best with the claim.
